Bravo Line is a Veloduct of NR Los Sengas Division. With 10 stations along the line, this line was established on September 9 2016, and runs between Intus Orient and Le Monde.

Description []

Bravo Line is one of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It passes through Torrent, Cometsilk, Yowah, Flask, Downtown, West Metropolis Archipelago and Twenty-Second Continent.

This line is represented by Light Orange on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number B.

This line shares tracks with New Edward Line and Alpha Line between Seat River and Compass Island, with Alpha Line between Compass Island and Edward Island, and with Stadium Line between Raytree and Prosand.

History[]

Important Dates[]

  • September 9 2016: This line was established.
  • February 19 2017: This line extended to Flask East Checkpoint (Then Flask East Station).
  • March 25 2017: This line merged with Echo Line.

Development Chapters[]

  • S2E6: Metropolis - Edward Island
  • S2E11: Prosand - Edward Island
  • S2E15: Prosand - Edward Island
    (Reserved platforms for this line were also built in Virtel Heights.)
  • S2E16: Intus Orient - Edward Island
  • S2E17: Intus Orient - Zerda Hill (Prosand Cancelled)
  • S3E13P2: Intus Orient - Darey Terrace
  • S3E14P2: Intus Orient - Le Monde

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • This line features in-train interchange with Fox Line, and is the first pair of Veloducts to do so.[1]
  • This line is the first Veloduct to feature two consecutive stations which also happen to be consecutive stations for another Standard Railway Line (Between Virtel Heights Station and Intus Orient Gateway. The Standard Railway is Stadium Line).
  • This line shares tracks with the following lines:
    • New Edward Line: Seat River (Exclusive, to the south) to Compass Island (Also shares tracks with Alpha Line)
    • Alpha Line: Metropolis (Exclusive, to the west) to Edward Island (Exclusive, to to the east) (Parts of this section also shares tracks with New Edward Line.)
  • Stadium Line: Raytree (Exclusive, to the west) to Prosand (Exclusive, to the west)
  • This line provides Express Services for the following lines:
    • New Edward Line (West): Metropolis to Le Monde. [2]
    • Stadium Line (East): Metropolis to Intus Orient (Through Flask East, Kong Corner, Pi Lake and Virtel Heights). [3]
    • Kinight Line: Edward Island to Darey Terrace (Through Zerda Hill)
    • Phoenix Line (East): Metropolis to Flask East
    • Akashi Line: Darey Terrace to Le Monde

Fun Facts[]

  • Original plans of this line involved serving Wativer Station to the west of Metropolis and Grass Crack Station to the east of Metropolis, but this plan was aborted. The former was instead served by Fox Line whereas the latter does not have any plans of having Veloduct services. Passengers who would like to go to Grass Crack Station may change to Stadium Line at Flask East Checkpoint or Kong Corner Station of this line.
  • This line has emergency platforms at Prosand Station and Calmé Station, with the former being a former stop of this line but was cancelled in S2E17. While this line would not normally stop at Prosand Station and Calmé Station, both of them were still considered in Station Numbering.
  • Two of the sections of this track serve as the Express Service of more than one Standard Railway Line:
    • Edward Island to Le Monde: New Edward Line (Throughout), Kinight Line (Edward Island to Darey Terrace), Akashi Line (Darey Terrace to Le Monde)
    • Metropolis to Flask East: Stadium Line, Phoenix Line

title: Brighton Hall
safeHtml:
Brighton Hall is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Central Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-09.

Contents

  • 1 History
  • 2 Housing

History[]

There has been two possible sources regarding the name of Brighton Hall. One of them has to do with paying homage to Denith Poon, a former member of the Hong Kong-based Beanies, and the other was the fact that the Poon Family, with the help of a Reverend whose family name was Brighton, had built a cathedral that illuminates the night even during fierce snowstorms. The Cathedral was named Brighton Hall, and in order to commemorate the lives that were saved, the hall had become the namesake of this area.

Since this area is located at the geographical center of Asylum, Brighton Hall had become the new City Center of Asylum in the redevelopment, which features administrative offices, including a District Court and a Government Office.

The Developer of this District had plans to built a large-scale interchange beneath the Brighton Hall Intersection, featuring several Bus Termini near the tentative location which could serve up to 28 Bus Lines as its terminus. However, changes in plans had meant that the Station would be moved to near the boundary with Exalt Gardens. With that being said, plans for The BRIGHTON Shopping Mall, and the Topside Development BRIGHTON HOUSE remain unchanged, and citizens who plan to go to the administrative offices only require a walking time of at most 10 minutes with any transport facility.

While this district was originally planned to house a large retail park, the location of the park became Sheung Yam Estate due to changes in plans.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Color Scheme of this station alludes to Lycoris Recoil, a Japanese Anime released in 2022. Multiple Elements within this station also alludes to this anime as follows:
    • The Chinese Name of this station and the Interchange Corridor of this station alludes to Chisato Nishigiki, one of the main protagonists of this anime.
    • This station began concourse construction on September 23, the birthday of Chisato Nishigiki. However, it did not begin services until six days later.
    • Café LycoReco is set up at the Concourse of this station, providing Blended Coffee, Sencha, Cookie biscuit, Dorayaki, Hot chocolate Parfait and Chisato's "Special Elegant" Parfait.
    • The Station Fountain located at the Center of the Concourse in this station alludes to the same fountain that appeared in Episode 3 of the anime at which the main protagonists hug each other. The quote spoken by Chisato also appeared next to the fountain in the form of the station art in this station.[2]
    • The Station Banner of this station features the logo that is present on the Uniforms of the Lycoris, a group of all-female agents in Direct Attack in which the main protagonists of the Lycoris Recoil work.
    • The Platform Walls at both ends are modelled after the two hackers from the animation "Robota" and "Walnut" for Platform 1 and Platform 2, respectively.
    • The Exit Passageways of this station are also based on different characters who appeared in the anime. More information on the character theme and its building materials could be seen at the "Exit Distribution" Section of this page.
  • Despite being located in the same area as the first phase of Cadence Line between Yowah Point and Echo Cliffs, initial development of Cadence Line did not include this station when it began services on September 22 2018. However, two years later, on June 11 2021, Gentle Island Pond Station began services near the tracks between Weaving Plate and Shadow Shore. Feasibility studies have been conducted, and it was decided that a station could be built to provide interchanges with Gentle Island Pond Station.[3]

Bufly Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is owned by the Los Sengas Government, and due to the completion of Bufly Island Station, this island is also the first island to begin development in West Metropolis Archipelago.

Contents

  • 1 Location
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 Nazca Railway
    • 2.2 HAMGOSASHI Light Rail Transport
    • 2.3 Nazca Ferry
  • 3 Bulidings
  • 4 Citations and References

Location[]

Bufly Island is named after the fact that it looks like a butterfly that is flying. The word "Bufly" is an amalgam and simplification of the words "Butterfly" and "Fly". It is located to the south of Sunrise Island, the west of West Shoal and the east of Droplet Island. Currently, Bufly Island is connectec to Butterfly Head Isle and Pointdown Isle.

Transport[]

Nazca Railway[]

  • West Ring Line, Luxter Line, Stadow Line Bufly Island Station

Bufly Island Station is a station on West Ring Line, Luxter Line and Stadow Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Bufly Island. Passengers may also use this station to change to HAMGOSASHI LRT Sun-Bufly Line East Bufly and West Bufly Stations.

Station Souvenir Hints (Now Inaccessible)[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.

  • Stars: 3
  • Answer five questions given at the signs. Answer the Questions by pressing the 26 buttons, each corresponding to an alphabet.
  • Only the First Letter of eaach answer is required.
  • Make sure to answer them in the correct order, or you have to answer all of them all over again.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a feather.

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 0.5-2 (Depending on the Parkour Skills of the Player)
  • Parkour your way to the finish line.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a pair of Elytra.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is the first Station to be built in West Metropolis Archipelago.
  • This station is the permanent Down Direction Terminus of Luxter Line.

History[]

  • April 6 2015: This station began services alongside West Ring Line and Luxter Line.
  • February 21 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[7]
  • December 31 2016: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[8]
  • May 25 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[9]
  • December 5 2018: This station completed expansion. During the expansion, several interchange passageways and a set of Island Platforms are provided for Stadow Line. At the same day, Stadow Line extends from Sunrise Island Station to this station.
  • August 27 2020: The Stadow Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[10]
  • January 6 2021: The Luxter Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[11]
  • April 9 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[12]
  • May 4 2022: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[13]

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station was initially named Kom Cin Wei Station during the planning stages of Glinstrouß Line, and this station was not meant to appear until after Phase I of Glinstrouß Line. Subsequent relocation of Kom Cin Wei, the namesake of this station, meant that the planned name of this station became Ng Kwai Shan Station and that this station had been moved to Phase I of Glinstrouß Line. However, right before construction, as per the request of the developer of Peckern North, the color scheme of this station became orange and purple, which are nearly contrast colors. As a result, red sandstone is used for orange, and purple wool is used for purple.[2] The two colors alludes to two different plants proposed by the developer which pays tribute to the name of antoher district, but due to historical reasons, the actual name of the plants became lost with time as the developer has forgotten the types of plants that he wanted to use.
  • This Station was originally planned to have a pair of island platforms that are 256m long. However, due to problems with planning, this station ended up using Side Platforms that are of normal length, and the 256m platforms are used at Tin Kam Station instead.[3]
  • A section of turn-back tracks exist to the south of this station which is 400m long and goes back to ground level in order to dodge an existing intersection.[4]
  • From the reserved ground structure of this station, it is implied that this station will get an additional concourse and exit in the future.

History[]

  • July 31 2021: This station began services.
  • July 9 2026: This Station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[5]

Bulldoze Island, also named New Judy Island, is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is located to the east of Peckern Continent, the west of Info Island and is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago that completed development. Due to historical reasons, it gained the name New Judy Island on September 2016, and on October 2 2016, Block Isle also became a part of New Judy Island's subsidiary islands.

Contents

  • 4 Fun Facts

  • 6 Citations and References

Location[]

Bulldoze Island is located in New Judith Sub-District, and neighbors Info Island and Big Tea Isle.

Fun Facts[]

  • Southern Loop also had plans to set up a Station on this island. However, due to changes in development plans, the plans never came to fruition.

History[]

  • February 4 2016: Development Permission Gained.
  • Between February and March 2016: Kafka Lane complete.
  • Between March and July 2016: Development on Hiatus
  • August 2016: Great Nazca Aquarium opened its doors, and caused the island to speed up development.
  • September 2016: This island is renamed New Judy Island. Infrastructure on this island complete/
  • October 2016: Most Residential projects complete.
  • October 10 2016: New Judy Port opened.
  • Mid-October 2016: Route 5 inserted exit at New Judy Island after repeated proposals.
  • November 9 2016: New Judy Island Monorail completed construction.
  • December 11 2016: New Judy Island development complete.
  • May 1 2017: Due to historical reasons, this island was renamed Bulldoze Island.

Station Souvenir Hints[]

  • Stars: 1

  • Find the Station Souvenir. It is NOT located within the station. Go to the southeast of the island to find the souvenir.

Fun Facts[]

  • When this station was completed, it had the same name as the current name. While this station was briefly renamed New Judy Island Station, it has been renamed the current name due to historical reasons.
  • The platforms of this station are 256m long. Currently, this station features the only set of platforms on Stadium Line which are longer than the standard length (204m).

History[]

  • June 30 2015: This station began services.
  • May 23 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[2]
  • January 21 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[3]
  • March 2 2020: Due to historical reasons, services for this are suspended.[4]
  • December 2 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]
  • January 30 2024: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.

Butterfly Head Isle was one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. At the time of its existence, it was located to the northwest of Bufly Island. However, due to the lack of usable land on Bufly Island, this isle, alongside Pointdown Isle and Beak Isle were reclaimed by Bufly Island. As a result, no trace of this isle's existence is found.

Cajotine Island Station was a planned station on Gondola Line. It would have been operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and would have been located on Cajotine Island. However, due to insufficient space on Cajotine Island, this station was never built.

Fun Facts[]

This station was formerly the first station of the Interisland Line branch from Earn Island Station (The sign for this station used to appear in the Station Control Room of Earn Island Station). Due to changes in plans, it would have been served by Gondola Line instead. However, a geological survey at that area had found that there is not enough underground space at Cajotine Island to build a station, and plans to build this station were scrapped, replaced by Decajotine Island Station.

Candor Plains Station is a station on Pegasus Line and Phoenix Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Katadelphia. Passengers may also use this station to change to Central-Yowah Railway Yowah Line (Candor Plains Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This page is the 2400th page of this wiki.
  • This station is the 400th station to be built in the Los Sengas Division.
  • This station is one of the two stations that enables Pegasus Line to interchange with Phoenix Line (Besides of Metropolis Terminal), with the other station being Sincerity Cove Station, which is a sister station of this station.
  • The two roads connecting to the east side and west side of this station provides connecting bus services and taxi services respectively.

History[]

  • May 31 2022: This station began construction.[2]
  • June 2 2022: This station completed construction.[3][4]
  • June 4 2022: This station began services alongside Pegasus Line. However, as Phoenix Line have yet to begin development, the Phoenix Line platforms remain reserved.
  • July 29 2022: This station completed setting up of Phoenix Line systems.[5] At the same day, Phoenix Line extends from Cyan Loop Station to this station.

Fun Facts[]

  • The North End of the Oasis Bay Line Platforms of this station are curved.

History[]

  • January 8 2017: This station completed construction.[3]
  • January 9 2017: This station began services alongside Flask Line, but Oasis Bay Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • January 13 2017: Oasis Bay Line is established.
  • July 24 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • April 11 2025: The existing Exits A, B are renamed Exits A2, A1 respectively, and Exits B1, B2 and the South Concourse are added to this station.[5]
  • April 24 2025: Exit C and the Shopping Street are added to this Station.[6]

Fun Facts[]

  • Due to the shallow Seabed, this station does not feature Oceanfloor Tubes at both ends of this station.
  • During the planning stages of Pegasus Line, this station was the Down Direction Terminus of Pegasus Line as the Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline did not mention Pegasus Line going to Rover in the initial stage. However, in Season 3 Episode 17, Pegasus Line would be constructed to Peacean Island Station.[2]
  • Due to the narrow road width above the station, Exits B and C of this station are constructed along the Entry Gate Area fence.

History[]

  • June 29 2022: This Station completed construction. At the same day, this station began services.[3]
  • July 8 2023: Exit E is added to this station.

Causeway Bay Station is a station on Glacier Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Glacier.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Name and Color Scheme of this station alludes to Causeway Bay Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.
  • Before the construction of this station, Ingress Flatland Station was the northbound terminus of Glacier Line for three years and nine months.[2]
  • This station, alongside Qoser Coast Station and Royal Mount Station, is one of the "anchor points" for Glacier Line climbing to Elevated level from the south. As a result, Side Platforms are used for this station.

History[]

  • October 13 2020: This station began services.

Caver Island Station is a station on West Ring Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Caver Island. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 501, Line 502 (Caver Island Stop) and Caver Light Railway Caver Line Heiwan and Snake Head Bay Stations.

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • A labyrinth of caves exit beneath the platform. If you go on the right track, then you can find it.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a torch.

Station Gauntlet[]

  • The theme and challenge modes of this Station Gauntlet are as follows:
    • Solo
    • Memory
    • Water

Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1.5-2
  • The clues to this Station Gauntlet could be seen at two of the staircases from the Concourse to the Platform. Take note of the chairs that look different, and start from the stairs closer to the access point to the Station Gauntlet.
  • The Chairs correspond to which button you should press.
  • Try not to drown. Until you solve the riddle, there is a place where you can emerge onto the water surface and breathe.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a torch.

History[]

  • May 17 2015: This station began services.
  • April 7 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[5]
  • June 28 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[6]
  • August 14 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[7]
  • June 30 2023: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.

Caver Island Station was a planned station on Southern Loop. It would have been operated by Peckern Transit, and would have been located in Caver Island. However, due to changes in development plans, this station was never built.

Fun Facts[]

  • While Northland Line also had plans to set up a station in here, the plans were scrapped on January 5 2017 following the establishment of the Eagle Island, Dark Pearl Island branch.

title: Caver Light Railway
safeHtml:
Caver Light Railway is the Light Rail System on Caver Island.

Station List[]

Currently, Caver Light Railway has one line with five stations. However, it is planned to have three lines with nine stations. The stations of Caver Light Railway are as follows, with Italic Text indicating that the station is not yet open:

  • Caver Line (Blue)
    • Caver Night Market Station (Interchange with West Coast Line)
    • Caver Studio Station
    • Heiwan Station (Interchange with Nazca Railway West Ring Line, SLT Line 501, Line 502, Hotel Express)
    • Snake Head Bay Station (Interchange with Nazca Railway West Ring Line)
    • Caver Walk Station
    • Caver Pier Station
    • White Sand Coast Station (Interchange with West Coast Line)
  • West Coast Line (Red)
    • West Studio Station
    • Caver Night Market Station (Interchange with Caver Line)
    • White Sand Coast Station (Interchange with Caver Line)
    • Vast Hotel Station (Interchange with Hotel Express)
  • Hotel Express (Green)
    • Heiwan Station (Interchange with Nazca Railway West Ring Line, SLT Line 501, Line 502, Caver Line)
